description: This file is a shell script containing a series of tests for Git's 'intent to add' functionality, including commands that manipulate the Git index, status, and diff outputs to verify correct behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case expecting the given command sequence to succeed.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected files or outputs, asserting they are the same.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock or state.

methods.name: test_git
methods.description: Runs git commands in the test environment.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Verifies that the output matches a given pattern.
